audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed while every one of the page's own why-lines says the opposite: Garen out-regens level 1, silences the Fling at 2, wins the straight brawl at 3, out-sustains at 4-5, and neither side has a clean 1v1 after items.
audit.why: The chart and the prose disagree on five of seven rows on a 50.83% matchup.
audit.corrected: Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Skill / Skill / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike never says what Insanity Potion does to Garen specifically, and the first-item spike overstates Rylai's.
audit.why: Perseverance regenerates a percentage of Garen's total health whenever he is not being hit — Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which is the direct answer and appears nowhere. Rylai's is real but Decisive Strike breaks all slows on an 8s cooldown, so the lap has to come after the Q.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds at 6; Rylai's qualified by the Q slow-break.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decisive Strike is only ever described as a silence. Riot's own text says it also breaks free of all slows.
audit.why: That single clause invalidates the page's whole Rylai's plan: Poison Trail's slow, Rylai's slow and Mega Adhesive's slow all wash off on an 8-second flat cooldown. It is the most important interaction in the matchup and it was absent. Courage (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s) shield plus tenacity and Demacian Justice (120/100/80s) true-damage execute are already handled correctly.
audit.corrected: State the slow-break and key the lap to the spent Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block tracks Courage and gives no numbers; the punishing cooldown is Decisive Strike.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s at every rank and is both the silence and the slow-break.
audit.corrected: Q 8s, W 22s at rank 1, R 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] pairs the title 'Kite through poison' with a description about Courage being wasted.
audit.why: Trigger and description do not match.
audit.corrected: Point the description at the Fling-into-glue root.

edits.before: You lose most level-1 duels — set up the proxy game instead. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Perseverance regen erases your poison chip the moment you stop, and you have no Fling yet — farm from the edge of the trail.

edits.before: Fling + glue starts punishing anyone who chases. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences on an 8s cooldown and cancels your Fling — do not commit while his Q is up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your range.
edits.after: Courage absorbs your opening and its tenacity shortens the root — your full pattern still loses the straight brawl.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Perseverance plus Courage out-sustains Poison Trail in a long trade — proxy behind his tower and deny gold, not health.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Rylai's holds him in the cloud, but Decisive Strike breaks all slows every 8s — lap him once he spends it.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Garen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items apiece and neither 1v1 is clean — split, and stay above Demacian Justice's execute line at all times.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Kite around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Garen Decisive Strike: 8s flat — it silences your Fling AND breaks every slow, so Rylai's and the glue wash off. - Courage: 22s at rank 1, shield plus tenacity. - Demacian Justice: 120s, true-damage execute.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction. Kite around it. When it is down — Poison-kite + fling him.
edits.after: Decisive Strike breaks all slows and silences your Fling, every 8s — commit only after he spends it.

edits.before: The lane has chapters — the chart is the table of contents.
edits.after: His lane until 6, then it evens out — read it row by row.

edits.before: Garen wastes Courage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Fling him into the glue for the root, then lap him in the trail.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter means enemies slowed by Poison Trail cannot sprint out, letting you lap Garen repeatedly and make every subsequent Fling unavoidable.
edits.after: Rylai's holds Garen in Poison Trail — except Decisive Strike breaks all slows on an 8-second cooldown, so lap him right after he spends the Q, never before it.

edits.before: Insanity Potion's armor and MR spike narrow the Judgment damage gap, but Garen's R execute threat and silence still mean every all-in is a coin-flip — trade small and bank the cs lead from proxying.
edits.after: Insanity Potion's armor and MR narrow the Judgment gap and its Grievous Wounds shuts Perseverance off, but his R execute and silence keep every all-in a coin-flip — trade small and bank proxy CS.

edits.before: At levels 4-5 leave the direct lane entirely and proxy behind his tower — run your Poison Trail through the incoming minion wave, deny him gold, and force him to either tower-dive a nearly-unkillable Singed or watch the wave vanish. When Garen chases through jungle terrain, your Mega Adhesive root plus Fling sends him the wrong direction and his passive regen does nothing while he is rooted inside your cloud. Hit level 6 and pop Insanity Potion before he can activate Courage: the bonus armor and MR cut Judgment's per-tick damage to the point where lapping him in poison is safer than it looks.
edits.after: At levels 4-5 leave the direct lane and proxy behind his tower — run Poison Trail through the incoming wave, deny him gold, and force him to either tower-dive a nearly-unkillable Singed or watch the wave vanish. When Garen chases through jungle terrain, a Fling that drops him into Mega Adhesive roots him and his passive regen does nothing while he is stuck in your cloud — but Decisive Strike breaks every slow on an 8-second cooldown, so glue him after the Q, not into it. At 6, pop Insanity Potion: the armor and MR cut Judgment's per-tick damage, and the Grievous Wounds it puts on Poison Trail is what finally switches Perseverance off.

notes: Level chart flipped as one atomic group across both layers; the prose already argued Garen owns levels 1-5 and the chart said the reverse. The decisive missing fact was that Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows on a flat 8s cooldown, which undercuts the page's Rylai's plan, and the answer to Perseverance is Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds — neither appeared anywhere. Mega Adhesive's grounding is irrelevant here (Garen has no dash) so nothing was written about it. UNVERIFIED and left alone: the existing claim that Courage's tenacity shortens the Mega Adhesive root specifically, and whether the Q silence can cancel Fling after the cast has started — needsResearch is empty in both kits.
